about: Each invariant of the P06 slice-1 contract (docs/contracts/p06.md) maps to the Rust tests (crates/franken-platform/src/net.rs) and Python tests (tests/p06/test_net_abi.py, tests/p06/test_ledger.py) that check it. A test named here must exist, and every Rust test in net.rs must be named here. `inapplicable` gives, per facet the bead lists (layout, errno, time_width, syscall, tls, target), the reason a facet does not apply to the invariant, or null when it does.

invariants.statement: Every socket, option and poll number a kernel call takes is the number of the ABI it is issued on: the socket types, SOCK_NONBLOCK, SOL_SOCKET, the options, POLLWRNORM and POLLWRBAND, and the 'common' block, equal the hand-written vectors; the two ABIs differ exactly where the vectors say; the 32-bit timeout options are used and the 64-bit ones never are.

inapplicable.tls: no thread-local storage is used (errno arrives in-band as -errno on both ABIs); network TLS authentication is not a P06 primitive (docs/contracts/p06.md, 'Applicability')
inapplicable.target: a unit test on the host; the BE targets are type-checked and linted centrally; execution on a BE target is pending and not claimed (docs/contracts/p06.md, 'Applicability')

invariants.statement: The ten network errnos are classified in the ABI that issued the call: a number names a network error on at most one ABI, only a decoded errno can be one, and the generic (PowerPC) numbering read on MIPS is wrong for every one of the ten.

invariants.statement: Time values keep the legacy widths: a socket timeout is 32-bit seconds and microseconds, rounded up; zero is refused because the kernel reads it as forever; seconds past 32 bits are refused and not truncated, and so are seconds at the old kernel's own no-timeout threshold (above 2,147,481 s); a poll timeout is an int of milliseconds that rounds up, can be none of 0 or -1 by accident, refuses what does not fit, and refuses a finite value above the old kernel's forever threshold (above 2,147,482 ms) instead of letting it silently become forever.

invariants.statement: A poll request is built only for a real descriptor and events the ABI knows; a returned count above the request, or a ready bit outside the ABI's known set, is not believed; an interrupted poll is retried with the time left and not with the whole timeout, a naive repeat of the call is told apart from it by a judge, and the retry is bounded and reports the interruption.

invariants.statement: A datagram read is issued with MSG_TRUNC and decoded as complete or truncated with the real length: the E03 loopback fact (24 bytes into a 16-byte buffer returns 24) is a truncation, an exactly-full buffer is complete, a length above the largest UDP payload (65,527) is refused, and EAGAIN on a nonblocking socket is a typed would-block.

invariants.statement: FrankenLibC's errno module at the E06 pin is the generic numbering: for every network errno it defines (nine of the ten) the number equals PowerPC's and differs from MIPS's, and ENOSYS is 38 against MIPS's 89; so removing its architecture compile_error alone would be a build that misreads MIPS, not a port.
